test_cases.name: TC01 – Standard Login with Valid Credentials
test_cases.description: Verify that a user with valid credentials can log in successfully and access the Map Scene. Ensures proper authentication and active session creation.

validation.input:
Launch the application.
Navigate to the login screen.
Enter a valid username: vt01229400001.
Enter a valid password: 0391.
Click Login.
validation.expected:
User is successfully authenticated.
Redirected to the Start Scene / Home page.
User session is created and remains active.

test_cases.name: TC03 – Login with Alternate Valid Accounts
test_cases.description: Validate that the system allows successful login using different valid pupil accounts. This ensures login functionality is consistent across multiple pupils and not limited to a single user credential.

validation.input:
Launch the application.
Navigate to the login screen.
Enter valid pupil credentials:Example 1: vt01229400001 / 0391
Example 2: (another valid pupil account, if available)

Click Login.
Log out (if required) and repeat with the next valid pupil account.
validation.expected:
Each pupil account is successfully authenticated.
Redirected to the Start Scene / Home page.
User sessions are created and remain active.
No account-specific login errors occur.

test_cases.name: TC06 – Invalid Credentials
test_cases.description: Verify login fails with wrong username/password.

validation.input:
Enter vt01229400001 in user name
enter 0000.
validation.expected:
Error message displayed: "Invalid username or password".
Login not successful.

test_cases.name: TC07 – Empty Fields
test_cases.description: Validate system response when fields are empty.

validation.input:
Leave Username empty → enter valid password.
Leave Password empty → enter valid username.
Leave both empty.
validation.expected:
Error messages shown (“Username required”, “Password required”).
Login button disabled until valid input.

test_cases.name: TC08 – Locked/Disabled Account
test_cases.description: Verify that locked pupil accounts cannot log in.

validation.expected:
Login blocked.
Error: "Account disabled. Contact support".

test_cases.name: EVT_01: Open Events page successfully
test_cases.description:
Test Overview:
This foundational smoke test validates that the VT-CRM Events management page loads correctly and displays all essential UI components required for event administration.
Business Value:
Ensures administrators can access the primary Events interface to manage educational events, which is critical for coordinating student competitions and learning activities across schools.
Components Validated:
• Events page title and navigation
• View Published Events navigation button
• Select Event dropdown functionality
• New Event creation link
• Schools/Classes selection grid
• Publish Event action button
Test Classification:
• Test Type: Smoke (Critical Path)
• Priority: High
• Execution Method: Manual verification
Dependencies:
• Admin user authentication
• VT-CRM system availability
• Database connectivity for event data
Notes:
Based on provided UI screenshots. This test serves as a prerequisite for all other event management test cases.

validation.input:
Preconditions:
Admin user is logged in
Test Steps:
Navigate to /admin/events
validation.expected: Events page loads successfully and displays the Events title, View Published Events button, Select Event dropdown, New Event link, schools/classes grid, and Publish Event button.

test_cases.name: Brickout - Solve successful Brickout activity on Medium difficulty

- Progress is saved and the activity is marked as completed
